## Receive Ports
Right click on **Receive Ports** -> **New** -> **One-way Receive Ports...**  
<img border="1" src="data:image/png;base64," />  

Give it proper **Name** and tick **Enable routing for failed messages**  
> **Enable routing for failed messages** allows BizTalk to pass failed messages to eHub so eHub would see failed messages and act accordingly.  

<img border="1" src="data:image/png;base64," />  

Click on **Receive Locations** -> **New...**  
<img border="1" src="data:image/png;base64," />  

## Receive Locations
Enter proper **Name** and **Description**  
> We use **Description** for simple changelog  

> To temporarily disable receive location, set **Receive handler** to **DISABLED**. You can't have disabled status for receive location as it would cause SCOM alert.   

<img border="1" src="data:image/png;base64," />  

### Receive Transport Type - FTPEx
For **Receive handler**, select **ReceiveHost_FTPEx**  
Configure as per specification. For best practice, set **Mode** to **Force PASV** and **Log Level** to **Debug**.
> For **Mode**, the default **Passive** has fallback. But the fallback doesn't work for all FTP servers. That's why it's best to use **Force PASV**. **Please TEST if PASV mode works on client's FTP since client may use active mode instead.**  

> For **Folder**, please keep in mind you are working with current login directory. You can specify slash (/) at the beginning to force it to root.  

<img border="1" src="data:image/png;base64," />  

### Receive Transport Type - SFTPEx
For **Receive handler**, select **ReceiveHost_SFTPEx**  
Configure as per specification. For best practice, set **Stream Transfers** to **False**  and **Log Level** to **Debug**  
> For **Folder**, please keep in mind you are working with current login directory. You can specify slash (/) at the beginning to force it to root.  

<img border="1" src="data:image/png;base64," />  


### Receive pipeline - Rcv_ResolveInboundMessage
#### XML
<img border="1" src="data:image/png;base64," />  

#### FlatFile
For best practice, remove carriage return via **DecodeValues** 
> For **DecodeValues** to work properly, schema needs to delimit by line feed.  

<img border="1" src="data:image/png;base64," />  



### Receive pipeline - Rcv_ResolveInboundEDIMessage
#### X12
Please set up **[parties](#parties)** and **[X12 agreement](#x12-agreement)** accordingly.  
<img border="1" src="data:image/png;base64," />  

#### EDIFACT
Please set up **[parties](#parties)** and **[EDIFACT agreement](#edifact-agreement)** accordingly. For best practice, set **EdiDataValidation** to **False** and configure **EfactDelimiters** according to specification.  
<img border="1" src="data:image/png;base64," />  


## Send Ports
Right click on **Send Ports** -> **New** -> **Static One-way Send Port...**  
<img border="1" src="data:image/png;base64," />  

Enter proper **Name** and **Description**  
> We use **Description** for simple changelog  

<img border="1" src="data:image/png;base64," />  

Click on **Transport Advanced Options**. Set **Retry count** to 100 and tick **Enable routing for failed messages**  
> **Enable routing for failed messages** allows BizTalk to pass failed messages to eHub so eHub would see failed messages and act accordingly.  

<img border="1" src="data:image/png;base64," />  

Set **Filters**  
<img border="1" src="data:image/png;base64," />  
> To temporarily disable send port, add an additional **NextStep** with **DISABLED**. You can't have disabled status for receive location as it would cause SCOM alert.  
> <img border="1" src="data:image/png;base64," />  

### Send Transport Type - FTPEx
For **Send handler**, select **SendHost_FTPEx**  
Configure as per specification. For best practice, set **Mode** to **Force PASV** and **Log Level** to **Debug**.
> For **Mode**, the default **Passive** has fallback. But the fallback doesn't work for all FTP servers. That's why it's best to use **Force PASV**. **Please TEST if PASV mode works on client's FTP since client may use active mode instead.**  

> For **Folder**, please keep in mind you are working with current login directory. You can specify slash (/) at the beginning to force it to root.  

<img border="1" src="data:image/png;base64," />  

### Send Transport Type - SFTPEx
For **Send handler**, select **SendHost_SFTPEx**  
Configure as per specification. For best practice, set **Stream Transfers** to **False**  and **Log Level** to **Debug**  
> For **Folder**, please keep in mind you are working with current login directory. You can specify slash (/) at the beginning to force it to root.  

<img border="1" src="data:image/png;base64," />  

### Send pipeline - Snd_PassThruTransmitWithLogging
<img border="1" src="data:image/png;base64," />  

For X12 or EDIFACT, please set up **[parties](#parties)** and **[X12 agreement](#x12-agreement)**/**[EDIFACT agreement](#edifact-agreement)** accordingly.

> For **X12 Usage indicator (ISA15)**, use pipeline's replacement function to bypass the limitation of BizTalk on running both production and test data at the same time.  
> <img border="1" src="data:image/png;base64," />  



## Parties
For X12, EDIFACT, and AS2, right click on **Parties** -> **New** -> **Party...** to create sender and recipient if not yet available  
<img border="1" src="data:image/png;base64," />  

Give them proper **Name**  
<img border="1" src="data:image/png;base64," />  

Select the parties and right click -> **New** -> **Agreement**  
<img border="1" src="data:image/png;base64," />  


### X12 Agreement
Give it proper **Name**. For **Protocol**, select **X12**  
<img border="1" src="data:image/png;base64," />  

Configure **Id Qualifier** and **Value** for both **Sender** and **Receiver**  on both tabs  
<img border="1" src="data:image/png;base64," />  

Go to **Transaction Set Settings** -> **Validation** and untick **Perform EDI Data Type Validation** on both tabs  
<img border="1" src="data:image/png;base64," />  

If it's custom schema, go to **Transaction Set Settings** -> **Local Host Settings** and set **TargetNamespace**  
<img border="1" src="data:image/png;base64," />  

#### Outbound
Configure **DestinationPartyName** to allow BizTalk to resolve/locate the agreement settings  
<img border="1" src="data:image/png;base64," />  

Configure **Interchange Settings** -> **Envelopes** according to specification  
> For **Usage indicator (ISA15)**, use pipeline's replacement function to bypass the limitation of BizTalk on running both production and test data at the same time.  
> <img border="1" src="data:image/png;base64," />  

<img border="1" src="data:image/png;base64," />  

Set **Character set and separators** according to specification. Tick **Replace separators in payload with** and set **dash (-)** or any other reasonable character  
<img border="1" src="data:image/png;base64," />  

Set **Transaction Set Settings** -> **Envelopes** according to specification.  
<img border="1" src="data:image/png;base64," />  



### EDIFACT Agreement
Give it proper **Name**. For **Protocol**, select **EDIFACT**  
<img border="1" src="data:image/png;base64," />  

Configure **Identification** and **Code qualifier** for both **Sender** and **Recipient** on both tabs  
<img border="1" src="data:image/png;base64," />  

Go to **Transaction Set Settings** -> **Validation** and untick **Perform EDI Data Type Validation** on both tabs  
<img border="1" src="data:image/png;base64," />  

If it's custom schema, go to **Transaction Set Settings** -> **Local Host Settings** and set **TargetNamespace**  
<img border="1" src="data:image/png;base64," />  

#### Outbound
Configure **DestinationPartyName** to allow BizTalk to resolve/locate the agreement settings  
<img border="1" src="data:image/png;base64," />  

Set **Character set and separators** according to specification  
<img border="1" src="data:image/png;base64," />  







## Tracking
You can turn tracking on for send port or receive port to see what BizTalk sees.  
<img border="1" src="data:image/png;base64," />  
<img border="1" src="data:image/png;base64," />  

Once message is processed by the port, click **BizTalk Group** -> **Tracked message events**  
<img border="1" src="data:image/png;base64," />  

Filter via **Port Name**  
<img border="1" src="data:image/png;base64," />
